name: GPT Image 2 Prompt Gallery
description: Curated, ready-to-use prompts for OpenAI gpt-image-2, with rendered case images.

prompts.title: Convenience Store Neon Portrait
prompts.prompt: 35mm film photography with harsh convenience store fluorescent lighting mixed with colorful neon signs from outside, authentic film grain, high contrast, slight color cast, cinematic street editorial style, intimate medium shot, early 20s woman with ultra-realistic delicate features, seductive almond-shaped eyes with natural double eyelids, high nose bridge, small sharp V-shaped jawline, flawless porcelain skin with cool ivory undertone and visible specular highlights from fluorescent light, subtle skin texture and micro pores, natural dewy makeup with soft flush on cheeks, glossy natural pink lips slightly parted, long dark hair in a messy high ponytail with loose strands falling around face, wearing an oversized white button-up shirt loosely tied at the waist, paired with a tiny black pleated mini skirt, seductive casual leaning pose against the glass door of a 24-hour convenience store at late night, bright cold fluorescent store light from inside mixed with pink and blue neon glow from outside signs, realistic reflections on glass door, blurred convenience store interior in background, authentic 35mm film color grading, no plastic skin, no watermark, no text
prompts.negative_prompt: no plastic skin, no watermark, no text
prompts.tip: Best with 9:16 output. Keep fluorescent + neon contrast strong; avoid plastic-skin fixes.
prompts.tip_zh: 推荐 9:16 出图，保留荧光与霓虹对比，避免肌肤过度磨皮。
prompts.author: @BubbleBrain

prompts.title: Boston Spring 2026 City Poster
prompts.title_zh: 波士顿春日 2026 城市海报
prompts.prompt: A striking Spring 2026 city poster for Boston with an elegant celebratory mood and a bold contemporary design. On a clean off-white textured background with large areas of negative space, a miniature single sculler rows across the lower right corner of the image on a narrow ribbon of reflective water. The wake from the oar sweeps upward in a dynamic calligraphic curve, gradually transforming into the Charles River and then into a dreamlike hand-painted panorama of Boston. Inside this flowing river-shaped composition are iconic Boston elements: the Back Bay skyline, Beacon Hill brownstones, Acorn Street, Boston Public Garden, Swan Boats, Zakim Bridge, Fenway-inspired details, historic brick architecture, harbor ferries, and the city's waterfront atmosphere. Soft morning fog, golden spring light, subtle festive accents in crimson and gold, rich detail, layered depth, sophisticated city-poster aesthetics, fresh and refined, visually powerful but not overcrowded. Elegant typography in the lower left reads 'SPRING 2026' with a vertical slogan 'BOSTON, A CITY OF RIVER, MEMORY, AND INVENTION', text clear and beautifully composed, premium graphic design, 9:16
prompts.tip: Render at high quality so 'SPRING 2026' typography stays crisp. Keep negative space generous.
prompts.tip_zh: 高质量出图保证文字 'SPRING 2026' 清晰，留白要够大。
prompts.author: @EvoLinkAI

prompts.title: Vintage Amalfi Coast Travel Poster
prompts.title_zh: 复古阿马尔菲海岸旅行海报
prompts.prompt: Modern pencil illustration of a vintage travel poster depicting the Amalfi Coast, Italy, panoramic coastal cliff road scene, classic 1960s white car driving along a curved seaside road, deep blue Mediterranean sea with small sailboats, colorful pastel hillside village, bright blue sky with soft clouds, lemon tree branches with vibrant yellow lemons framing the foreground, warm summer sunlight, bold vibrant colors, retro 1950s travel poster style, cinematic composition, high detail, screen print texture, graphic illustration. Hand-drawn style with loose strokes and defined contours. High-contrast color palette, contemporary and decorative aesthetic.
prompts.tip: Lock subject = 'Amalfi Coast' and reference '1950s travel poster' for the right gouache feel.
prompts.tip_zh: 强调 1950s travel poster + 丝网印质感，避免被现代插画覆盖。
prompts.author: @EvoLinkAI

prompts.title: Adventure Character Design Sheet
prompts.title_zh: 冒险角色三视图设定稿
prompts.prompt: Create a detailed character design sheet for Lira, a young female explorer-mechanic-inventor in her early 20s. Include front, side, and back turnaround views in T-pose. She wears an olive-green fur-lined parka with copper buckles, a golden hand-knit scarf, leather utility belt with brass tools and small gears, weathered cargo trousers, and worn brown leather boots. Add an array of six expressive facial expressions in a top row (curious, determined, surprised, thoughtful, mischievous, proud). Include an equipment breakdown panel: brass goggles, leather-bound journal, hand-cranked lantern, and a compact mechanical wing-pack. Bottom corner: small thumbnail of a snowy mountain village at dusk where she lives. Clean off-white parchment background with pencil grid guidelines, soft watercolor wash, refined ink linework, character sheet typography labels in elegant serif, professional concept art style, 16:9.
prompts.tip: Lock the spec lists (clothes, expressions, equipment) — gpt-image-2 follows them strictly.
prompts.tip_zh: 明确写出服装/表情/装备清单，gpt-image-2 会逐项渲染。
prompts.author: @BubbleBrain

prompts.title: SaaS Analytics Dashboard (Dark Mode)
prompts.prompt: A SaaS analytics dashboard in dark mode. Charcoal background (#1a1a2e) with cards showing: a line chart of monthly revenue in gradient green, a donut chart of traffic sources, a data table of top products, and KPI cards with up/down trend arrows. Sidebar navigation on the left with icons. Subtle glass-morphism effect on cards, Inter font, 8px border radius throughout. High-fidelity UI mockup, pixel-clean rendering, accurate typography, 16:9.
prompts.tip: Spell out font + radius + hex bg. gpt-image-2 renders crisper text than other models.
prompts.tip_zh: 明确字体、圆角、背景色。gpt-image-2 文字渲染特别清晰，写细一些就行。

prompts.title: Sci-Fi Movie Teaser Poster: INVENTOR
prompts.prompt: Create a cinematic sci-fi movie teaser poster in 16:9 landscape format. A lone woman stands in silhouette at the edge of an enormous cubic chamber filled with hundreds of glowing holographic data screens that float in concentric rings around her. Cool cyan and amber rim light. A faint particle haze drifts through the air. Title 'INVENTOR' in wide-spaced uppercase serif typography across the top, with a tagline 'DISCOVERY IS JUST THE BEGINNING' below in small letter-spaced sans-serif. prompts.title: Vintage Tokyo Jazz Club Poster
prompts.title_zh: 复古东京爵士俱乐部海报
prompts.prompt:
Vintage 1960s music poster for a Tokyo jazz club, hand-drawn lithograph style,
saxophone player silhouette against deep teal background, warm mustard accents,
bold sans-serif Japanese-English bilingual title "TOKYO BLUE NOTE", visible paper grain,
slight ink misregistration, off-white margins. No photorealism. High-contrast print look.
prompts.negative_prompt: no modern fonts, no gradients, no glossy finish
prompts.tip: Specify a print era (e.g. '1960s lithograph') to lock the texture and color treatment; ask for 'ink misregistration' to get authentic vintage feel.
prompts.tip_zh: 指定具体年代和印刷工艺（如 1960s lithograph）能稳定锁住纹理与配色，加 "ink misregistration" 更复古。
prompts.author: Capy

prompts.title: Minimalist Skincare Bottle on Marble
prompts.title_zh: 极简护肤品瓶大理石场景
prompts.prompt:
Studio product photo of an unbranded matte ceramic skincare bottle on a polished white Carrara marble surface,
soft directional window light from upper-left casting a long subtle shadow,
single sprig of fresh green eucalyptus leaning against the bottle, pure white seamless backdrop fading behind,
shallow depth of field, hyper-clean editorial aesthetic, photographed with 100mm macro lens.
prompts.negative_prompt: no logo, no text, no harsh reflections, no glossy bottle
prompts.tip: Ask for a specific lens focal length (e.g. 100mm macro) and a window-light direction to lock professional studio realism.
prompts.tip_zh: 指定镜头焦段（如 100mm 微距）和窗光方向，写真感更稳定。
prompts.author: Capy

prompts.title: Isometric Cozy Coffee Shop
prompts.prompt:
Isometric 3D illustration of a cozy two-story coffee shop cutaway, warm afternoon sunlight
streaming through bay windows, exposed brick walls, hanging Edison bulbs, espresso machine on the counter,
bookshelf with potted plants, baristas working, two customers reading, second floor with a study nook,
soft pastel palette of cream / terracotta / sage green, sharp clean linework, subtle ambient occlusion.

Character design sheet for a young Asian female mech pilot, age 22, sharp facial features,
undercut bob with neon teal streaks, full-body armored flightsuit with exposed joint cabling,
glowing visor helmet held in one hand, holstered sidearm, scuffed boots,
